Manx: prowal dy chosoylaghey priosyn gass vannin roosyn echey cholught bree
t'eh dy bollagh neuphersoonagh reirey stiureyder as reireyder-jeshaghtys dan cholught manninagh
robert ec jerrey yn chiaghtin shoh chaie dooyrt lughtee
dy beagh ad giarrey coontys gass cliaghtagh son custom-marym thieoil sy reeriaght unnaneysit liorish queig sy cheead
veih'n chiaghtoo laa toshiaght arree ny lurg tuittym mooar ayns priosyn gass slane eck kyndagh rish yn emshyr vlaa
ta loayrt gass vannin gra nagh vod ad giarrey ny priosyn oc ec y traa t'ayn
er-yn-oyr dy vel ad kionnaghey gass laccal son y gheurey
dy phrowal stiurey bishaghey'n preis as shickyraghey costyssyn son ymmydeyryn-gass
ta mainshter gra dy hrog gass vannin y treisht jeh gass na dooragh liorish jees queig sy cheead
as y treisht-jee gass ushlagh liorish hoght cheead mee luanistyn shoh chaie
tra hie priosyn meanagh seose liorish queig jeig sy cheead sy reeriaght unnaneysit
as t'ee gra nagh vel eh resoonagh dy chosoylaghey price son y daa cholught cheu ry heu
